notes.title: Patch #7 - Paint job
notes.content:
Hello there fellow pilots! Here we are again with a big bunch of fixes, features and lube jobs! Please tell us what you think of Rebel Wings so we can make it even better! Stay tuned for more, retail release approaching..

Rebel Wings 0.13
New: The UI has been updated to provide a more streamlined experience.
New: The settings menu is now available in game.
New: In CTD, each team now has separate spawn points.
New: Revamped sound effects for machine-gun, flak-gun etc.
New: Redesigned the CTD map to make it a little more symmetric.

Fix: Fixed an issue with the grinder colliding with the Anubis statue on the Dunes-map.
Fix: Allow-bots checkbox should now sync to other players.
Fix: The camera always starts in the center of the map now.
Fix: The camera now respect map-bounds better.
Fix: Join/leave messages are now shown in the chat-box instead of at the top of the screen.
Fix: The UI should scale as expected on virtually all resolutions.
Fix: Fixed an issue with sound settings not saving after playing a round.

notes.title: Patch #6 - Attack of the Drones
notes.content:
Today's patch brings a couple of visual improvements for the new game mode, Capture the Drone! We hope you're having lots of fun with Rebel Wings and we always look forward to hearing from you in the Community Hub.

[b]Rebel Wings 0.12[/b]
[list]
[*] New: Added an amazing™ effect to celebrate Drone captures.
[*] New: Visual indication when the Drone Base is ready for capture.
[*] New: The Drone has gotten a new and shiny animation, and a leash!
[*] Fix: Default Score to Win is now 3 on Capture the Drone.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #5 - Capture the Drone
notes.content:
Big update fellow pilots! Capture the Drone is a new game mode where two teams battle to capture the enemy team's drone and return it to their base to score points. We've had a blast building and testing it and we hope you will as well. See you airborne!

[b]Rebel Wings 0.11[/b]
[list]
[*] New: A brand new game mode, Capture the Drone!
[*] New: A new shortcut to host games from the server browser.
[*] Fix: The chat panel is now properly closed when disconnecting with it open.
[*] Fix: The sound effect for button clicks are now also affected by the sound effects volume.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #4 - On top!
notes.content:
After an intense start of the new year we are proud to announce Rebel Wings patch number 4! As always, we appreciate your continued support of the game and we value every bit of feedback that you leave in the community hub and reviews.

[b]Rebel Wings 0.10.5916[/b]
[list]
[*] New: Top-3 list with players to see who's about to win!
[*] New: Added a host setting to play without bots.
[*] New: Score labels on Team Deathmatch.
[*] New: Notification sound when someone joins or leaves your game.
[*] New: Say "Hi" to the new Rebel Wings 3D logo in the main menu!
[*] Fix: The Grinder is now the same color as your plane.
[*] Fix: Increased the size of text in some UI elements.
[*] Fix: Size tweaks on the standing Anubis so you can fly through it with the Grinder.
[*] Fix: The fallen Anubis had lost its collision properties, oops!
[*] Fix: The Village map now has the correct, more narrow, width.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #3 - Bombastic
notes.content:
Hey! 
The new patch for Rebel Wings has just been released. We have managed to squeeze in a lot of smaller stuff as well as a couple of bigger things. 

First off, r1sc has been hard at work creating a new airplane model - the Bomber! Sleek and stealthy it slices through the air spreading impending doom on its foes. 

Video of the Bomber in action: https://gfycat.com/PleasantDeterminedArcherfish

Secondly, the windswept desert landscape in "Dunes" has gotten some attention and we've added a couple of landmarks to liven it up.

Here's the patch notes:

[b]Rebel Wings 0.9.5875[/b][list][*] New: The Bomber makes its first appearance in Rebel Wings!
[*] New: Polished the Dunes map.
[*] New: Added a setting to control the "Screen Shake" effect.
[*] New: Added a subtle button click sound in the menu.
[*] Fix: The chat window fades out gradually when not focused.
[*] Fix: The chat window is now properly cleared between games.
[*] Fix: Auto spawn doesn't take focus from chat input.
[*] Fix: Auto spawn checkbox focused only if using gamepad.
[*] Fix: Team balance in TDM works a bit better.
[*] Fix: The respawn timer now resets correctly on all players between rounds.
[/list]

There are some known issues that we have found while testing the game:
[list]
[*] Volume sliders in the Settings menu stops working after you have played a game. Restart is required.
[*] The team assignment that you see in the lobby might not match the actual team that you're assigned to in-game.
[/list]
We would like to thank everyone that participated in the "Play vs. Devs" session last week, it was a lot of fun and very interesting to hear your comments on the game. Hopefully we'll be able to plan a new session soon - keep your eyes peeled to the Announcement section!

Over and out...

notes.title: Patch #2 is out!
notes.content:
Thank you all for the continued support of Rebel Wings. We hope to add more content and exciting updates during the course of the Early Access run so stick with us!

[b]Rebel Wings 0.8.5870.35899[/b][list]
[*] New: See what powerup you've just picked up in a new and shiny popup.
[*] New: The default name of new games is a bit more personalized.
[*] New: The map changes after each round to keep you on your toes.
[*] New: You can now choose to automatically respawn after you die.
[*] Fix: You can now access the "Cancel" join button and quality settings with your game pad.
[*] Fix: "Connecting" dialog when you start the game from "Join" in Steam.
[*] Fix: Names of players who disconnect now show up properly.
[*] Fix: Mouse cursor is now locked inside the window if it is focused.
[*] Fix: Comprehensible message when no games were found in the server browser.
[*] Fix: Separated the chat from the action log.
[*] Dev: Er... Fixed the error reporting.
[/list]

There are some known issues that we have found while testing the game:
[list]
[*] Volume sliders in the Settings menu stops working after you have played a game. Restart is required.
[*] If you're dead when the round is over you will have to wait for the respawn timer next round instead.
[/list]

See you in the fray and don't forget to join the "Play vs. Devs" session at 20:00 CET tonight!

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Today marks the first patch for Rebel Wings on Early Access. We appreciate all the feedback we've received so far and hope to see more of you in-game soon!

Keep leaving your impressions and thoughts on the discussion page and we will do our best to reply.

[b]Rebel Wings 0.7.5853.39117[/b]
[list]
[*] New: You can now chat with your friends and foes via the in-game chat!
[*] New: Added a brief explanation of the powerups and controls.
[*] New: Choose when to respawn by pressing the "Fire" button
[*] Fix: You can now cancel an attempt to join a game.
[*] Fix: The host can now select score limits in intervals of 5 (instead of 10).
[*] Fix: The quality setting "Fastest" should now work as intended.
[*] Dev: Added error reporting.
[/list]

There are some known issues that we have found while testing the game:
[list]
[*] Volume sliders in the Settings menu stops working after you have played a game. Restart is required.
[*] Low resolutions (< 1280x800) does not scale well.
[*] Gamepad navigation is broken for quality settings and the cancel-join button.
[/list]

[*] New: Choose when to respawn by pressing the "Fire" button

tags.balance_change: [*] Fix: The host can now select score limits in intervals of 5 (instead of 10).
